legal.templateNotice: This page is a starting template, not legal advice. It was generated from the developer’s answers about the app and must be reviewed by the developer before anyone relies on it.

identifier.anonymous-id: an anonymous ID generated by the app

dataCategory.user-content: the content you create in the app
dataCategory.device-info: basic device information (such as model and Android version)
dataCategory.photos-media: photos and media you choose to add

policy.title: {app} privacy policy
policy.intro: This policy explains what the Android app {app} does with information. The app is published on Google Play by {developer}, based in {country}.

short.deviceOnly: The app stores your data on your device and does not send it to us.
short.server: The app sends some information to a server so that it can work. Details are below.
short.noAccount: The app has no user accounts.
short.payments: Purchases are handled by Google Play.
short.noPayments: The app has no in-app purchases.
short.noSdks: The app has no third-party analytics or crash-reporting services.

who.heading: Who we are
who.body: {app} is published by {developer}, based in {country}. You can reach us at <mail>{email}</mail>. Our website is <web>{site}</web>.

collect.heading: Information the app handles
collect.deviceOnly: {app} keeps its data, such as your settings and the things you create in it, on your device. That information is not sent to us or to any server run for the app, so we cannot see it.
collect.deviceOnlyServices: {app} keeps its data, such as your settings and the things you create in it, on your device. The app does not send that information to us, so we cannot see it. The sections below describe the other services involved, which handle some information separately.
collect.deviceBackup: Depending on your device settings, Android may include app data in your Google account backup. That is controlled by your device and Google settings, not by us.
collect.server: The app sends the following to a server so that it can work: {list}.
collect.serverUse: We use this information to provide and maintain the app’s features and to answer your requests.
collect.account: To create an account, you give us: {list}.

services.heading: Third-party services
services.sdks: The app includes these third-party services: {list}. Depending on the service, they may collect information such as crash reports, device information and how you use the app, and they handle it under their own privacy policies.
services.noSdks: The app does not include third-party analytics or crash-reporting services.
services.play: Installing and updating the app through Google Play is covered by Google’s own terms and privacy policy.

ads.heading: Advertising
ads.on: The app shows ads provided by {list}. Ad providers may collect device identifiers, such as your advertising ID, and information about how you interact with ads, and they handle it under their own privacy policies.
ads.onChoice: You can reset your advertising ID or opt out of ad personalization in your Android settings.
ads.off: The app does not show ads.

purchases.heading: Purchases
purchases.on: Purchases in the app are made through Google Play Billing. Google processes the payment, so we never see or store your payment card details. Google tells us about your purchases (for example the item bought, the order ID and its status) so that we can unlock what you bought and help you if something goes wrong.
purchases.off: The app does not offer in-app purchases.

permissions.heading: Permissions
permissions.on: The app may ask for these permissions. You can refuse them, or withdraw them later in your device settings.
permissions.off: The app does not ask for any permissions that need your approval.

sharing.heading: Sharing
sharing.some: We share information only with the service providers named in this policy, and when the law requires it.
sharing.none: We do not share information with anyone, because the app does not send any to us.

retention.heading: How long information is kept
retention.deviceOnly: Information stays on your device until you delete it, clear the app’s storage or uninstall the app.
retention.untilDeletedAccount: We keep the information linked to your account for as long as the account exists. When you delete the account, we delete the information as described on the account deletion page.
retention.untilDeleted: We keep this information until you ask us to delete it.
retention.afterLastUse: We delete this information {period} after you last use the app. You can ask us to delete it sooner.
retention.thirdParty: Third-party services keep information according to their own policies.

choices.heading: Your choices and deleting your data
choices.deleteAccount: You can delete your account and the data linked to it at any time. Instructions are on this page: <delete>Delete your account and data</delete>.
choices.deleteServer: To ask us to delete the information we hold about you, write to <mail>{email}</mail>.
choices.deleteDevice: You can remove all of the app’s data from your device by clearing the app’s storage or by uninstalling the app.
choices.rights: Depending on where you live, you may have rights over your information, such as asking to see, correct or delete it. To use them, write to <mail>{email}</mail>.
choices.question: You can write to us at <mail>{email}</mail> with any question about your information.

security.heading: Security
security.body: We take reasonable steps to protect the information we hold, but no system is completely secure.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If we change how the app handles information, we will update this page and its “Last updated” date. Please check it from time to time.

websitePolicy.title: Website privacy policy
websitePolicy.intro: This policy covers this website only. Each app has its own privacy policy.

short.noTracking: No analytics, no ads, no tracking scripts.
short.logs: Like any web host, {host} keeps server logs.
short.noEmbeds: Nothing is loaded from other sites.

who.heading: Who runs this website
who.body: This website is published by {developer} ({studio}), based in {country}. It is hosted by {host}. You can reach us at <mail>{email}</mail>.

collect.heading: What this website collects
collect.forms: Nothing you type: the site has no forms, accounts, comments or search.
collect.logs: Server logs at the host. When you open a page, {host} receives your IP address, the page you asked for, the time, and technical details your browser sends, such as its type and the page that linked here. The host keeps these logs to deliver the site and keep it secure, under <hostlink>its own privacy policy</hostlink>. We do not use them to track or profile you.
collect.logsPlain: Server logs at the host. When you open a page, {host} receives your IP address, the page you asked for, the time, and technical details your browser sends, such as its type and the page that linked here. The host keeps these logs to deliver the site and keep it secure, under its own privacy policy. We do not use them to track or profile you.
collect.email: Your email, if you write to us. We receive your address and your message, use them only to answer you, and keep the conversation for as long as we need to deal with it.

none.heading: What this website does not do
none.cookies: It sets no cookies and uses no local storage.
none.analytics: It has no analytics or tracking scripts.
none.embeds: It loads nothing from other sites: no embedded videos, maps, fonts or social buttons.

links.heading: Links to other sites
links.body: Links such as the Google Play buttons lead to sites run by others. Those sites have their own privacy policies.

apps.heading: Our apps
apps.body: Each app has its own privacy policy:

choices.heading: Your choices
choices.body: This website keeps no personal information of its own beyond what the host logs and the emails you send us. To ask about an email you sent, write to <mail>{email}</mail>.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If this website starts to collect anything new, we will update this page and its “Last updated” date first.

deletePage.title: Delete your {app} account and data
deletePage.intro: This page explains how to ask {developer} to delete your {app} account and the data linked to it. You can use it without opening the app or signing in.

how.heading: How to ask for deletion
how.emailBody: Send an email to <mail>{email}</mail> from the address linked to your account, with the subject “{subject}”. Or open a ready-made message: <request>Email a deletion request</request>.
how.verify: To protect your account, we may ask you to confirm that it is yours before we delete anything.
how.partial: If you want only some of your data removed and want to keep your account, say which data in your email and we will delete just that.

deleted.heading: What is deleted
deleted.intro: When we delete your account, we delete the information linked to it, except what is listed in the next section. This includes:

kept.heading: What is kept, and for how long
kept.none: We do not keep your information after your account is deleted.
kept.intro: Some information has to be kept after your account is deleted:
kept.backups: Copies of your information may remain in our backups for up to {period} after deletion, and are then removed.
kept.play: Purchases made through Google Play are recorded by Google, which keeps them under its own policies. Deleting your account with us does not change those records.
kept.third: Information held by the third-party services named in our privacy policy is kept under their own policies. We cannot delete it for you.

device.heading: Data on your device
device.body: Data stored only on your device cannot be reached by us. Uninstall the app or clear its storage to remove it.
